name: Actapio

profile.reading: Actapio, Inc. is a wholly owned US subsidiary of LY Corporation, the Japanese technology company formerly known as Z Holdings and, before that, Yahoo Japan Corporation. Actapio operates data center capacity in Washington State, with third-party facility tracking placing its campus in the Wenatchee and Douglas County area at approximately 16 megawatts of critical IT load, a figure this registry treats as a lead pending direct confirmation rather than a verified fact from Actapio or LY Corporation directly. The companys own site describes its Washington location as chosen for access to low cost, clean hydroelectric power, which reduces operating costs relative to running equivalent infrastructure in Japan. Actapios stated services include cloud computing, computer system and server rentals, and application hosting, built on open source infrastructure, and it has been covered in AI and open compute industry press for GPU-based automation work supporting its parent companys AI models. Beyond hosting, Actapio also runs a secondary consulting business helping American startups expand into the Japanese market, drawing on LY Corporations established presence there. As a hyperscale parents dedicated US infrastructure subsidiary rather than a third-party colocation provider, Actapios role in this registry is closest to the other corporate-captive operators already profiled, such as the hyperscalers, though at a much smaller single-site scale. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
